exposure: belief about natural methods being safe
outcome: fear of sexually transmitted diseases and pregnancy
cohort: The study participants were 549 voluntarily students at Josip Juraj Strossmayer University of Osijek.
finding: The study found that 71.9% of students used birth control, primarily condoms, but 27.9% believed natural methods were safe, with the main reason for non-use in long-term relationships being a lack of fear of STDs and pregnancy.
cross-section timing: Performed at a single, unspecified point in time
